chunks: My father narrated to us, may God be pleased with him, saying: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Abi Ja'far Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, saying: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Forat narrated to us, from Ali ibn Matar, from Al-Sakan al-Khazzaz, who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) say:
It is the right of God upon every mature man, on every Friday: to trim his moustache and his nails, and to apply some perfume.

key_terms.مُحْتَلِمٍ: Mature man (one who has reached puberty)

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended acts of grooming and hygiene for men on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this specific 'Haqq Allah' (right of God) in *Al-Khisal*, highlighting the Imam’s emphasis on *fitrah* (natural disposition) and personal hygiene as acts of worship preceding the Friday congregational prayer. This practice underscores the Shia tradition of combining spiritual devotion with physical purity, ensuring the believer presents themselves in an elevated state for communal worship.
